name: Reporting a Problem
description: Learn how to report equipment issues or safety concerns appropriately
grammar_focus: ～に問題があります (there is a problem with ~)
どんな～ですか (what kind of ~)
cultural_notes: Reporting problems promptly is a safety responsibility
Direct communication with supervisors is valued
Problems should be reported immediately, not hidden

nodes.speaker: worker
nodes.text: すみません、この機械に問題があります。
nodes.english: Excuse me, there is a problem with this machine.

nodes.speaker: worker
nodes.expected_response: 今朝から動きません。変な音がします。
nodes.english: It hasn't worked since this morning. It makes a strange noise.

nodes.speaker: supervisor
nodes.text: わかりました。少し待ってください。確認します。
nodes.english: Understood. Please wait a moment. I'll check it.

nodes.speaker: supervisor
nodes.text: メンテナンスが必要です。別の機械を使ってください。
nodes.english: Maintenance is needed. Please use another machine.
